description:
Turn your training into real progress. SharpIt is the smart training log built for endurance athletes who want to plan clearly, train consistently and improve for the long run.

By reading your watch data through Apple Health, SharpIt analyses your recovery, training load and form every night, so each morning you make the right call: train, adapt your session or recover.

PLAN WITH PRECISION • Your season and goals in one clear, structured view. • A training plan that adapts to your life and to the unexpected. • Smart adjustment of your training volume to avoid overtraining.

TRACK YOUR SESSIONS AND HOW YOU FEEL • A complete log for cycling, running and triathlon. • Morning verdict: a daily reading of your sleep, heart rate and HRV. • Follow your form, fatigue and real feelings day after day.

ANALYSE AND TALK TO YOUR COACH • In-depth analysis of your key metrics after every session. • An AI coach available any time, answering your questions from your own training data. • Clear weekly reviews to measure your progress week after week.

YOUR PRIVACY, FULLY RESPECTED • Your training and health data belong to you. • No ads, no data resale and no hidden cloud sync.

Join SharpIt and give your training the consistency and structure it deserves.

SharpIt Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) that you can cancel at any time from your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use: https://sharpit.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sharpit.app/privacy
promotionalText: A coach that reads your night, your load and your plan every morning, and tells you what today's session should be.
